title: Director Advanced Manufacturing
text:
About the company

We're an EV commercial vehicle manufacturer based in Orange County, California. We design and build our medium-duty electric vehicles in-house, and next year's production is already fully sold out.

* 1,000+ vehicles built so far
* A 2,000-vehicle order from one of the largest US parcel carriers, due by end of 2027
* $650M+ raised, including a $200M+ Series recently
* Growing beyond trucks into energy storage, autonomy and defense

The role

We've sold out of trucks, and we don't want it to happen again. We're hiring a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to grow our production capacity and own how we get there.

You'll lead the team that designs, buys and launches our new lines and equipment. Your decisions will show up directly in how many trucks leave the factory each month.

What you'll do

* Lead and grow the advanced manufacturing engineering team
* Own the manufacturing strategy and capital plan for scaling production
* Take new lines and equipment from concept through design, build, install, testing and start of production
* Plan capacity so production keeps ahead of customer demand
* Run equipment and facility projects to budget and schedule, and present them to the executive team
* Work closely with vehicle engineering, supply chain and operations so new designs can be built at volume
* Bring in integrators and equipment suppliers, and manage them through delivery

What you'll bring

**Must have**

* 8+ years in manufacturing engineering, with 4+ years leading teams
* A track record of growing production capacity: new lines, factory expansions or ramping to full rate
* Hands-on experience taking equipment from specification through install, testing and launch
* Experience building and managing capital budgets
* A degree in engineering (mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, chemical or similar)

**Nice to have**

* Background in EV, automotive, commercial vehicles or batteries. High-volume aerospace, heavy equipment or other complex hardware also welcome.
* Start-up or scale-up experience, ideally through early production and ramp-up
* Experience building a new factory from the ground up

degree.text: A degree in engineering (mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, chemical or similar)
